Container.Name: ARTscale
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Tailscale control server (headscale) with a web console for reaching customer networks on demand. Turn each customer's subnet routes on and off, with a conflict guard for customers that share the same subnets and auto-off timers. Works with the standard Tailscale apps. Setup: point one Nginx Proxy Manager host (Websockets on) at the WebUI port and enter that same https address as the Public headscale URL; your devices and the console share it. Forward UDP 3478 on your router to Unraid, then get the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Console and device traffic. Point your Nginx Proxy Manager host here, with Websockets Support on.

Config.Name: Headscale port
Config.Description: Optional. headscale directly; only needed if you give devices a separate address with its own NPM host. Not used in the normal single-address setup.

Config.Name: STUN port
Config.Description: Relay STUN. Must stay 3478 and be port-forwarded (UDP) from your router to Unraid.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: headscale database and keys, ARTscale settings and activity log, and the auto-created API key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Public headscale URL
Config.Description: The public HTTPS address every Tailscale device uses, normally your console address, e.g. https://artscale.example.com. Devices remember it, so pick one you'll keep.

Config.Name: Public IPv4 for relay
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to look it up through DNS (best if your IP changes). Set it only if your public IP is static.

Config.Name: Public IPv6 for relay
Config.Description: Optional. Only if you have a public IPv6 address.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy networks
Config.Description: Where Nginx Proxy Manager's requests come from (comma-separated CIDRs), so login lockout sees real visitor IPs. Add NPM's own IP if it runs on br0.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: auto = secure over HTTPS (through NPM) and still works over plain HTTP on your LAN. true = HTTPS only. false = never.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the appdata files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the appdata files (100 = users).
